title: Thresholded batch steering and loss-aware quant presets
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: We observed tail-cost spikes for workloads with mixed short/long sequences where aggressive batching+quantization reduced unit cost but caused occasional quality regressions and latency SLO violations under heavy short-request tail. This PR introduces a thresholded batch-steering policy plus loss-aware quantization presets that (1) bias short requests to lower-latency small batches, (2) progressively enable compact quant profiles only when the workload signal indicates stable quality, and (3) provide a shadow-econ run for 24h for safe rollout. Summary of changes: - Add a BatchSteering controller that monitors per-route sequence-length histogram and routes requests to micro-batches when short-request fraction > threshold. - Implement ThresholdConfig with workspace-level defaults and route overrides. - Add a LossAwareQuantProfile generator which scores quant profiles by an estimated quality delta derived from sampled evals and production shadow runs. - Shadow-econ mode that runs a parallel scoring path to estimate cost vs quality tradeoffs without impacting live traffic. - Integration with the Console to surface the suggested profile and projected unit-econ improvement. Checklist: - [x] BatchSteering controller + metrics and unit tests - [x] Quant profile generator + integration tests - [x] Shadow-econ orchestration and config flags - [x] Console UI hook and telemetry - [x] Canary rollout (1%) followed by 24h shadow run - [x] Documentation (docs/runbooks/cost-optimizer.md) Backwards compatibility: default behavior remains unchanged unless customers opt into the ThresholdConfig or workspace defaults are updated. Rollout plan: opt-in feature flag on dedicated and hosted accounts, 1% canary for 48h, 24h shadow-econ to collect quality signals, then gradual ramp based on quality gates. Related work: builds on ENG-1125 (batch-aware router), ENG-1819 (prefill sampling), ENG-1972 (econ-sampler).

release_notes: Introduce Thresholded BatchSteering and Loss-Aware Quant Presets: opt-in feature to reduce unit cost for mixed-length workloads while guarding quality via shadow-econ evaluation. Console shows suggested profile and projected cost savings. Rollout is gated by quality checks.

qa_instructions: 1) Enable feature flag on staging for a workspace with mixed short/long routes. 2) Start 24h shadow-econ run and confirm shadow cost metrics appear without affecting live responses. 3) Verify Console suggests a quant profile and that per-route breakdown matches expected distribution. 4) Run regression evals in tests/eval/quant_regressions to ensure <0.5% quality delta on top-5 prompts.
human_summary: This PR adds a new policy to steer short requests into small micro-batches and to only apply compact quant profiles when a shadow-eval indicates minimal quality impact. It is opt-in and rolls out via canary + 24h shadow. The change is intended to lower unit cost for mixed-length workloads without increasing quality regressions.
